item.tib: gdong sgom bstan pa lhun grub kyi rnam par thar pa yid 'dzin gter gyi dga' dbang
item.coloph: zhes 'di phyi kun la mi dman pa/ skyabs mgon dam pa wer ya aShi Ni'i rnam (par) thar pa'am/ bstan pa lhun grub kyi rnam par thar pa'am gnas lugs gi (kyi) klong du gcig zhing*/ yid 'dzin gter gyi dga' dbang zhes pa/ dkar po zhes sa mo sbrul lor/ gnas chen bon ri mjal la phyin skabs/ rang gi nyon phung gi lo ma breg pa'i gtsug gi sdom pa chig dril du gnang ba'i/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de'i rnam par thar pa thob tshe lta bu zhig gis dpe dang zhal rgyan sogs gnong (gnang) ba'i bka' gnad la bsten nas/ rang blos 'tshams pa'i rab myos zhes pa/ lcags pho rta'i lor/ bkra gsal zla bar/ dbug cha'i lhun po dam can 'du nyin/ res gza' lha yi bla ma/ rgyu skar putrA lha mo/ spar kha lcags dkar khro bo/ sme ba bdud kyi dpa' bo/ nyi khyim sgra brgya'i bdag po/ dus sbyor skye rgu'i stobs ldan/ brten (rten) 'brel ming gis brgyad pa/ dbyangs yig u d+ha chu ro/ tshes ni bzang po dag gi bkrun/ 'dod yon gzugs kyi mtshan pa/ 'byung ba u khu chu/ na tshod rgyas pa gzhon bcas phun gsum (sum) 'tshogs nyin/ lhag bsam pad mo rgyas pa/ nye lo wer zhes pa'i phyag dang bcas te/ kha bkang (skong) bgyis pa dge ba'i las tshogs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba chen por gyur gcig(cig)/
